data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Christos', meaning 'Anointed One'. In Christian tradition, the name Kristy is believed to symbolize the presence of Christ in the life of the bearer. The name Kristy carries the meaning “Christ” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kristy usually hope their child will grow to embody christ and live with faith, good character and purpose.
